r: But Talion said that you could.
Can you also give 'blessings' of Fatigue and Life Drain

dds_jolnor_110.m: Borvis can't even manage those?! How unworthy!

dds_jolnor_112.m: Of course I could, if I wanted to.

dds_jolnor_120.m: There's one priest, Favlon, who can give you both. However, he went researching in the area west of Sullengard and hasn't been seen since.

dds_jolnor_22.m: So Talion still can't tell a blessing from a spell.

dds_jolnor_26.m: If Talion says - OK, it's yours for only 300 gold. Though it's not a blessing as such...
r: That is too much. I'd offer you 50 gold at the most.
300? I have to get some gold first.

dds_jolnor_28.m: Your choice. Come again, when you are wiser.

dds_jolnor_50.m: What do you want it for?
r: Well, Borvis wanted it to break through a Shadow shield, as someone is misusing Shadow powers to the south of Stoutford.

dds_jolnor_60.m: Tsk! Tsk! Not strong enough, is he? Sending a kid to do a priest's duty?

r: [Thinking to himself] He's probably just doing this to distract me so I can't figure out how to do it.

dds_jolnor_80.m: Here you go. Take it to Borvis with care.
r: Please, I still have a question.

dds_talion_132.m: It'll just cost you another 300 gold pieces.
r: I don't have that much with me. I'll be back.

jolnor_chapel_1.m: This is Vilegard's place of worship for the Shadow. We praise the Shadow in all its might and glory.
r: Can you tell me more about the Shadow?
I require healing. Can I see what items you have available?
Whatever. Just show me your goods.

jolnor_default.m: Walk with the Shadow my child.
r: I was told to talk to you about why everyone in Vilegard is suspicious of outsiders.

jolnor_default_2.m: Walk with the Shadow my child.
r: Can you tell me again what this place is?
Let's talk about those missions for gaining trust that you talked about earlier.
I require healing. Can I see what items you have available?

jolnor_default_3.m: Walk with the Shadow my friend.
r: Can you tell me again what this place is?
I require healing. Can I see what items you have available?
I need some help finding out who is responsible for casting a Shadow spell that causes a person to become noticeable.
The blessing has worn off too early. Could you give it again?

jolnor_gaintrust_1.m: If you do us a favor, we might consider trusting you. There are three people I can think of that are influential here in Vilegard, that you should try to help.

jolnor_gaintrust_10.m: Yes, their reason is to make life miserable for us, I am sure.
r: What do you want me to do?

jolnor_gaintrust_11.m: My reports say that there is a guard stationed outside the tavern, to keep an eye on potential dangers.

jolnor_gaintrust_12.m: I want you to make sure the guard disappears somehow. How you do that is purely up to you.
r: I am not sure I should upset the Feygard patrol guards. This could really get me into trouble.
For the Shadow, I will do as you ask.
OK, I hope this leads to some treasure in the end.

jolnor_gaintrust_13.m: It's your choice. You can at least go check out the tavern and see if you find anything suspicious.

jolnor_gaintrust_14.m: Good. Report back to me when you are done.

jolnor_gaintrust_15.m: So, in order to gain our trust here in Vilegard, I would suggest you help Kaori, Wrye and me.
r: Thank you for the information. I will be back when I have something to report.

jolnor_gaintrust_2.m: First, there is Kaori. She lives up in the northern part of Vilegard. Ask her if she wants help with anything.
r: OK. Talk to Kaori. Got it.

jolnor_gaintrust_3.m: Then there is Wrye. Wrye also lives up in the northern part of Vilegard. Many people here in Vilegard seek her advice on various things.

jolnor_gaintrust_4.m: She recently lost her son in a tragic way. If you can gain her trust, you will have a strong ally here.

jolnor_gaintrust_5.m: And last but not least, I have a favor to ask of you as well.

jolnor_gaintrust_6.m: North of Vilegard is a tavern called the Foaming Flask. In my opinion, this tavern is a guard station in guise for Feygard.

jolnor_gaintrust_7.m: The tavern is almost always visited by the Feygard royal guard of Lord Geomyr.

jolnor_gaintrust_8.m: They are probably here to spy on us, since we are followers of the Shadow. Lord Geomyr's forces always try to make life difficult for us and the Shadow.
r: Yes, they seem like troublemakers all around.
I am sure they have their reasons for doing what they do.
What do you want me to do?

jolnor_gaintrust_return.m: As I said before, you have to help some people here in Vilegard to gain our trust.

jolnor_gaintrust_return_2.m: With your help earlier, you have already gained our trust.

jolnor_guard_1.m: Yes, what about him. Have you removed him yet?
r: Yes, he will leave his post as soon as this shift is over.
No, but I am working on it.

jolnor_guard_2.m: Very good. Thank you for your help.
r: No problem. Let's get back to those other tasks we talked about.

jolnor_guard_completed.m: Yes, you dealt with him earlier. Thank you for your help.

jolnor_quests_1.m: I would suggest you help Kaori, Wrye and me to gain our trust.
r: About that guard outside the Foaming Flask tavern...
Never mind, let's get back to those other topics.
What was I supposed to do again?
I have done all the tasks you asked me to do.
Never mind, let's get back to those other topics.

jolnor_quests_completed.m: Good. You helped all three of us.

jolnor_quests_completed_2.m: I suppose that shows some dedication, and that we are ready to trust you now.

jolnor_quests_completed_3.m: You have our thanks, friend. You will always find shelter here in Vilegard. We welcome you into our village.

jolnor_quests_kaori_1.m: You still need to help Kaori with her task.

jolnor_quests_wrye_1.m: You still need to help Wrye with her task.

jolnor_shadow_1.m: The Shadow protects us from the dangers of the night. It keeps us safe and comforts us when we sleep.

jolnor_shop_2.m: I don't trust you enough yet to feel comfortable trading with you.

jolnor_suspicious_1.m: Suspicious? No, I wouldn't call it suspicion. I would rather call it that we are careful nowadays.

jolnor_suspicious_2.m: In order to gain the trust of the village, an outsider must prove that they are not here to cause trouble.
r: Sounds like a good idea. There are a lot of selfish people out there.
That sounds really unnecessary. Why not trust people in the first place?

jolnor_suspicious_3.m: Yes, right. You seem to understand us well, I like that.
r: Is there anything I can do to gain your trust?

jolnor_suspicious_4.m: We have learned from history not to trust outsiders, and you are an outsider. Why should we trust you?
r: What can I do to gain your trust?
You are right. You probably should not trust me.

tt_jolnor_10.m: Excuse me? I don't know what you want from me.

shadows.10: I met Borvis on the great road near Alynndir's hut.
shadows.20: Since I had told Gandoren about the switch of the weapons, and also the truth about the bootlegging of beer from Sullengard, he told me to leave.
shadows.30: Since I aided the Shadow once or twice earlier, he requested my further help for an urgent task.
shadows.40: He wanted me to investigate something bad in the Purple Hills in the weird areas to the south of Stoutford.
shadows.50: I went to the area to the south of Stoutford, and encountered an impassable force there.
shadows.60: There were strange glowing, immovable pebbles there. I had to inform Borvis.
shadows.70: Borvis told me that was the basic, but effective, Shadow shield, to protect Shadow incantations from outside interference.
shadows.80: For that, he would give me a chant. But I had to get him energies in the form of four 'blessings' - Shadow's Strength, Shadow Awareness, Fatigue, and Life Drain - within myself. He told me to go to Talion in Loneford for the first blessing, and for information about the others.
shadows.90: Talion bestowed me with Shadow's Strength.
shadows.100: Talion told me to seek out Jolnor in Vilegard for the rest of the 'blessings'.
shadows.110: Jolnor bestowed me with Shadow Awareness.
shadows.120: Jolnor told me to seek Favlon to the west of Sullengard for the remaining two.
shadows.130: I reached Favlon who asked me for 10 Cooked Meat.
shadows.140: I gave Favlon 10 Cooked Meat. He bestowed me with 'blessings' of Fatigue and Life Drain.
shadows.150: After a grueling travel back, I returned to Borvis.
shadows.160: Borvis removed the 'blessings' from me, and made a chant.
shadows.165: Borvis told me to hurry back to the barrier.
shadows.178: After destroying the ritual statue of Kazaul, beyond the barrier I found a crying woman.
shadows.180: She was performing a ritual that should bring her husband back to life.
shadows.190: Borvis, who followed me, convinced the woman that it was actually an evil ritual to overrun Dhayar with Kazaul's monsters.
shadows.200: The mourning woman told us that the ritual was given to her by a priest in the lava wastelands.
shadows.210: We let the mourning woman go.
shadows.212: The mourning woman cried that she would never be happy again.
shadows.220: I had to travel to the lava wastelands.
shadows.230: There, after fighting monsters, I met a priest in red.
shadows.240: He accused me of interfering again and again. Borvis, who again followed me, revealed the red priest to be a monster.
shadows.260: Borvis fulfilled his promise and told me that Andor would be refilling his supplies from Alynndir.
shadows.290: He told me he couldn't come home now, and vanished.

vilegard.10: The people of Vilegard are very suspicious of outsiders. I was told to go see Jolnor in the Vilegard chapel if I want to gain their trust.
vilegard.20: I have talked to Jolnor in the Vilegard chapel. He suggests I help three influential people in order to gain the trust of the people in Vilegard. I should help Kaori, Wrye and Jolnor in Vilegard.
vilegard.30: I have helped all three people in Vilegard that Jolnor suggested. Now the people of Vilegard should trust me more.

wrye.10: Jolnor in Vilegard chapel wants me to talk to Wrye in northern Vilegard. She has apparently lost her son recently.
wrye.20: Wrye in northern Vilegard tells me that her son Rincel has gone missing. She thinks that he has died or gotten critically hurt.
wrye.30: Wrye tells me that she thinks the royal guard from Feygard are involved in his disappearance, and that they have recruited him.
wrye.40: Wrye wants me to go search for clues as to what has happened to her son.
wrye.41: I should go look in the Vilegard tavern and the Foaming Flask tavern north of Vilegard.
wrye.42: I heard of a boy being in the Foaming Flask tavern a while ago. Apparently he left to the west of the tavern somewhere.
wrye.80: To the northwest of Vilegard I found a man that had found Rincel fighting some monsters. Rincel had apparently left Vilegard by his own will to go see the city of Feygard. I should go tell Wrye in northern Vilegard what happened to her son.
wrye.90: I have told Wrye the truth about her son's disappearance.

kaori.5: Jolnor in Vilegard chapel wants me to talk to Kaori in northern Vilegard, to see if she wants any help.
kaori.10: Kaori in northern Vilegard wants me to bring her 10 bonemeal potions.
kaori.20: I have brought 10 bonemeal potions to Kaori.

jolnor.10: Jolnor in Vilegard chapel tells me of a guard outside of the Foaming Flask tavern, that he thinks is a spy for the Feygard royal guard. He wants me to make the guard disappear, in any way that I see fit. The tavern should be just north of Vilegard.
jolnor.20: I have convinced the guard outside the Foaming Flask tavern to leave after his shift ends.
jolnor.21: I have started a fight with the guard outside the Foaming Flask tavern. I should bring his Feygard royal guard ring to Jolnor once he is dead to show Jolnor that he has disappeared.
jolnor.30: I have told Jolnor that the guard is now gone.

troubling_times.10: I went to the Thieves' Guild in Fallhaven looking for things to do.
troubling_times.20: Since I had helped Defy, Umar and Nanath threw me out. I cannot enter the basement again.
troubling_times.30: Since I had looted the Thieves' Guild vault after killing Defy, Umar and Nanath threw me out. I cannot enter the basement again.
troubling_times.40: I met Nanath, who's scared and upset, because someone put a spell on all members of the Thieves' Guild. This spell made all thieves noticeable. He asked me if I could help dispel the spell.
troubling_times.50: Nanath told me to find the Shadow priest who had cast the spell on the Guild.
troubling_times.60: I set out interviewing Shadow priests to find who had cast the spell.
troubling_times.70: Talion, Shadow priest of Loneford, had cast the Striking Spectacle Shadow spell on the Guild, on payment from Dameni, a mysterious lady leading a band of toughs
troubling_times.80: Talion could dispel the spell, using a few items - Villain's ring, Troublemaker's ring, ring of backstabbing, Tears of the Shadow potion, Luthor's ring.  He also wanted 50000 gold.
troubling_times.82: I have informed Nanath about the Striking Spectacle Shadow spell and Talion's demands.
troubling_times.90: Nanath told me Thieves' Guild would give me the 50000 gold back when I have got the spell dispelled.
troubling_times.95: Nanath asked if I had already found Luthor's ring.
troubling_times.100: I went back to Nanath as I couldn't find Luthor's ring anywhere.
troubling_times.105: He told me to seek out Fanamor's friend Sly Seraphina near the Sutdover bridge.
troubling_times.110: Seraphina didn't believe me. She told me to go away.
troubling_times.115: Nanath sent me to Umar. He should make sure Sly carries out the order.
troubling_times.120: Umar told me one of his secret passwords to convince Seraphina.
troubling_times.130: Sly Seraphina said that Luthor's ring was to be found in the cave which Crackshot tried to open. The door was sealed by Umar and Seraphina to prevent monsters in that cave from devastating Dhayavar. The sealing was done by using Luthor's items. She and Umar decided to separate them, and keep them separate.
troubling_times.140: Seraphina felt that the danger was too high to open that door. So she disappeared.
troubling_times.150: I had to find Sly Seraphina again.
troubling_times.160: Nanath told me to look for her in her usual hiding places: Near one of the towns Sullengard, Stoutford, Vilegard, Prim, Loneford, or Brimhaven.
troubling_times.170: Talion said that without the items he asked for he couldn't help. I had to find Seraphina.
troubling_times.180: After beating the tough guys protecting Seraphina, she was convinced that I was strong enough to help her beat the monsters in the cave.
troubling_times.190: Seraphina gave me back the money she had stolen from me earlier.
troubling_times.192: I have to ask Umar for Luthor's key.
troubling_times.195: Seraphina agreed to help me and told me to meet her at the locked door in the cave where Crackshot was defeated.
troubling_times.200: I met Seraphina at the cave door where Crackshot was defeated.
troubling_times.210: Seraphina could open the door with Luthor's key wearing also his gloves. She entered the cave behind the door.
troubling_times.230: Seraphina got injured attacking one of the monsters.
troubling_times.240: I have killed the monsters blocking the entrance.
troubling_times.252: I tried to poison Seraphina, but she noticed in time. At least she didn't notice that I did it on purpose.
troubling_times.255: Seraphina already started the search for the ring.
troubling_times.260: I searched the cave for Luthor's ring. I couldn't find it.
troubling_times.270: Sly Seraphina had found the ring. She gave it to me and told me to keep it safe. She disappeared again, probably back to Sutdover bridge. I had to go to Talion.
troubling_times.280: I gave 50000 gold, Villain's ring, Troublemaker's ring, ring of backstabbing, Tears of the Shadow potion, and Luthor's ring to Talion.
troubling_times.290: Talion used them to undo the spell.
troubling_times.300: Talion returned Luthor's ring. The other rings were broken in the process though and the Tears of the Shadow potion was used up of course.
troubling_times.302: The room with the dangerous creatures has been locked and sealed again.
troubling_times.310: Nanath gave me 75000 gold as a reward for a job well done.
troubling_times.320: Sly Seraphina was friendly to me - for now.

sk.fightstyleUnarmedUnarmored: Fighting style: Way of the monk
